title: Escape or a click outside does not close the window
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Choose a name for term A.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type the name of term A in Name.
  3. Type 14 in the Days box.
  4. Press Escape.
  5. Click on the page outside the window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Credit Term" window opens.

Step 2:

  • The Name reads term A.

Step 3:

  • The blue information line shows below the options.

Step 4:

  • The window stays open, with term A and 14 still typed.

Step 5:

  • The window stays open, with everything still typed.
